Visitor replaces button with bracketed text

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitButton(NodeContext ctx, String text) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom(String.format("[BTN:%s]", text));
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>Confirm action: <button type=\"submit\">Click me</button> or <button type=\"reset\">Cancel</button></p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
